# changelog-cleaning

This action does the following:

- Takes the path to a file in the current directory (the caller's `CHANGELOG.md` generated by towncrier)
- Cleans the file contents so it can appear in the website docs and inserts the preamble
- Commits the cleaned file to a destination repo (i.e [metalbear-co/docs-changelog](https://github.com/metalbear-co/docs-changelog))

In the case of metalbear-co/docs-changelog, GitBook will update the live docs to reflect the new version of the
changelog.

It previously lived in `metalbear-co/ci`, which is archived. The operator repo consumes it from here, as
`metalbear-co/mirrord/.github/actions/changelog-cleaning@main`.

### Inputs

- **local_file_path**: Path to the local file to read
- **destination_repo**: Destination repository in owner/repo format
- **destination_file_path**: Relative path to the destination file within the destination repo
- **checkout_directory**: Directory into which the destination repository can be checked out
- **git_user**, **git_email**, **git_access_token**: Identity and token for the commit

The preamble inserted at the top of the published page is set by the caller, so that one action can publish the
changelog of more than one repo:

- **title**: Title of the published page
- **description**: Description of the published page
- **tags**: Comma separated tags for the published page
- **date**: Publication date of the published page, as `YYYY-MM-DD`

If the source changelog carries a handwritten header above towncrier's `<!-- towncrier release notes start -->`
marker, the header is dropped. mirrord's `CHANGELOG.md` has one, the operator's `public/CHANGELOG.md` does not.
